title: FACS of acutely isolated mouse microglia
protocol: Perfuse mouse thoroughly transcardially with pH 7.4 0.1M PBS.
Remove heads with scissors.
Strip skulls of soft tissues.
Remove mandibles.
Remove all skull material rostral to maxillae.
With surgical scissors, remove tops of skulls, cutting clockwise, beginning and ending inferior to the right post-tympanic hook.
Scoop out brain, maintaining tissue integrity.
Place brains immediately in ice-cold FACS buffer \(pH 7.4 0.1M PBS, 1mM EDTA, 1% BSA, 50U/ml DNAseI).
Carefully strip meninges (dura mater, arachnoid mater and pia mater) from the exterior surfaces of brains with Dumont #5 forceps.
Using a scalpel, separate brain into cerebrum and cerebellum/brainstem with a coronal cut.
Using forceps, separate cerebellum from brainstem; carefully peel out meningeal lining of the fourth ventricle.
Using a scalpel, bisect the cerebrum longitudinally and carefully peel out the choroid plexus and associated meningeal tissue.
Further dissect into desired brain areas for analysis (e.g., hippocampus, neocortex, etc.).
Transfer brain tissue to a 15mL Tenbroeck homogenizer containing 10 ml ice-cold FACS buffer.
Break up tissue with three gentle strokes.
Press crude homogenate through a 70 μm nylon mesh cell strainer with a plastic plunger, two times in serial.
Centrifuge cells at 1200 RPM at 4°C for 10 minutes with no brake.
Remove supernatant and re-suspend cells in ice-cold FACS buffer.
Remove myelin using Miltenyi AutoMACS and myelin removal beads according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Wash cells once with FACS buffer, centrifuge cells at 1100 RPM at 4°C for 10 minutes with no brake.
Remove supernatant and re-suspend cells in 100 μl ice-cold FACS buffer.
Transfer cells to FACS tubes.
Label cells for extracellular microglial markers with antibodies each to CD11b, CD45, fixable live/dead dye, and any other desired markers for 30 minutes at 4°C; keep protected from light.
Wash cells two times as in the previous washing step.
Resuspend cells in 100-400 μl 1% PFA in 0.1M pH 7.4 PBS.
Vortex and store at 4°C protected from light.
Read cells on a multicolor flow cytometer.
Gate first using LIVE/DEAD, selecting live cells.
Select singlet cells by pulse width vs. area.
Eliminate debris by forward scatter vs. side scatter.
Identify cell type by appropriate markers for cell type (e.g., CD45 Low CD11b High for microglia; high levels of CD45 for peripheral leukocytes).
